_comment: Copy this file to linkedin_config.json and fill in your own values. linkedin_config.json is gitignored and never committed. Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored by the agent.

search._keywords_comment: Ordered list, searched one at a time. The agent starts at the top and offers the next one when you want more. Put the phrases employers actually use as job titles first.

resumes.label: A short name you choose - not restricted to any particular vocabulary (e.g. 'QA', 'Design', 'Ops', whatever fits your situation)
resumes.useWhen: Describe what kind of posting this resume fits - the agent matches postings against this text to pick the right resume

resumes.label: Another label of your choosing
resumes.useWhen: Describe what kind of posting this second resume fits

experienceSummary.background: A few sentences of background context the agent should know when judging fit.
experienceSummary._defaultExperienceYears_comment: field = your main profession in a few words (e.g. 'barista', 'accounting', 'software testing'). years = your total years in that field. The agent uses years only for general questions about that field. Leave years as null if unsure - the agent will ask instead of guessing.

defaultExperienceYears.field: Your main profession in a few words

experienceSummary._skillYears_comment: One entry per skill or tool you may be asked about: 'Skill name': years. Replace the placeholder below. A value of 0 means you have no experience with it. null or a missing skill means the agent will stop and ask you rather than guess.

coverLetterBlurb.template: A short reusable blurb the agent can adapt per posting.
